title: Decreto 7-2013 Ley Marco para Regular la Reduccion de la Vulnerabilidad, la Adaptacion Obligatoria ante los Efectos del Cambio Climatico y la Mitigacion de Gases de Efecto Invernadero
citation: Decreto 7-2013 del Congreso de la República, Diario de Centro América of 2013-10-04 (Tomo CCXCVIII, No. 3)
evidence: Congreso's PDF is the gazette page set: masthead "Guatemala, VIERNES 4 de octubre 2013 - DIARIO de CENTRO AMÉRICA" and Art. 28: "Vigencia. La presente ley entrará en vigencia a los ocho días de su publicación en el Diario de Centro América." Eight days after 2013-10-04 is 2013-10-12; the date is computed, no page states it. Congreso's listing gives the emission date as Thursday, 05 September 2013. Opened https://www.congreso.gob.gt/assets/uploads/info_legislativo/decretos/2013/07-2013.pdf on 2026-11-03 (curl 200 application/pdf 1162782).
notes: Climate framework act. Art. 9 (national climate change information system): public and private entities must give MARN the climate information it requests, GHG emissions and reductions especially; the duty is on request, with no periodic report or threshold (F3 content). Art. 22 (carbon market projects) says the rights, tenure and trading of emission-reduction units will be regulated; no carbon-market regulation was found. Art. 28 sets entry into force. No general reglamento of the Ley Marco was found. The PDF is a scan of a whole gazette page with other instruments in interleaved columns and OCR errors (pdftotext output 66962 bytes, garbled), so no record is made. Row GT-CONGRESO-ADOPTED is permission requested. No government English translation was looked for beyond the Congreso, MARN and DCA sites, which list none.
status_note: Row GT-CONGRESO-ADOPTED is permission requested (footer: all rights reserved) and the only official text is a garbled scan of a gazette page
